websocket.mjs (#458): ctx.serveWs is the far end of a program's WebSocket through the kernel's proxy. curl ws:// gets the far end's text and binary messages and close code; wss:// goes through the kernel's TLS termination; a refused open is 502; a raw client (bash on 127.0.0.1:3128) gets 101 with RFC 6455's accept, its masked frames reach the far end and come back, and its close reaches the far end; ctx.wsLog() records each socket
